title: 考试以前的二十分钟 Kǎoshì yǐqián de èrshí fēnzhōng — Twenty minutes before the exam
summary: Twenty minutes before an exam a missing bag teaches Ah Ling a better place for her keys.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: Ā Líng míngtiān shàngwǔ kǎo Hànyǔ.
body.en: Ah Ling takes her Chinese exam tomorrow morning.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 今天晚上，她找不到了自己的学生包。
body.py: jīntiān wǎnshang, tā zhǎo bú dào le zìjǐ de xuésheng bāo.
body.en: Tonight she cannot find her student bag.

body.speaker: 阿玲
body.py: Bāo lǐ yǒu bǐjì hé yàoshi.
body.en: The bag holds my notes and my keys.

body.speaker: 阿玲
body.zh: 我下午还用它买过东西。
body.py: wǒ xiàwǔ hái yòng tā mǎi guò dōngxi.
body.en: I still used it this afternoon to buy things.

body.speaker: 室友
body.zh: 别急。你先坐下来想一想。
body.py: bié jí. nǐ xiān zuò xiàlai xiǎng yíxiang.
body.en: Do not panic. Sit down and think for a moment.

body.speaker: 阿玲
body.en: Could it be in the laundry room?

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 两个人一起下楼，包在洗衣机上面。
body.py: liǎng gè rén yìqǐ xià lóu, bāo zài xǐyījī shàngmian.
body.en: The two go downstairs together and the bag is on the washing machine.

body.speaker: 室友
body.zh: 下次把重要的东西放在一个地方。
body.py: xià cì bǎ zhòngyào de dōngxi fàng zài yí gè dìfang.
body.en: Next time keep important things in one place.

body.speaker: 阿玲
body.zh: 你说得对。我总把它们放在口袋里。
body.py: nǐ shuō de duì. wǒ zǒng bǎ tāmen fàng zài kǒudài lǐ.
body.en: You are right. I always put them in a pocket.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 回屋以后，阿玲把笔记读了三遍。
body.py: huí wū yǐhòu, Ā Líng bǎ bǐjì dú le sān biàn.
body.en: Back in the room, Ah Ling reads the notes three times.

body.speaker: 室友
body.py: nǐ kàn, yàoshi zài nǐ shǒu shang.
body.en: Look, the keys are in your hand.

body.speaker: 阿玲
body.py: tā yìzhí zài wǒ shǒu shang!
body.en: It has been in my hand all along!

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: bǐjì zài bāo de zuì xiàmiàn.
body.en: The notes are at the very bottom of the bag.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: nà tiān tā kǎo le jiǔshíyī fēn.

body.speaker: 阿玲
body.zh: 分数很好，那个习惯更好。
body.py: fēnshù hěn hǎo, nàgè xíguàn gèng hǎo.
body.en: The score is good, and the habit is better.

blocks.title: Words in this story
body: 学生包 xuésheng bāo — school bag
最下面 zuì xiàmiàn — at the very bottom

blocks.body: Think about it: Where was the bag and what new habit does Ah Ling take away? Use the 把 bǎ frame in one of your answers.
